newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs seen volatile ahead of options expiry.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs seen volatile ahead of options expiry.

text.p: Brazil shares are seen volatile Thursday as speculation ahead of the June 16 options settlement is likely to intensify in coming days, brokers said.
With only seven sessions before the options expiry date, stocks are expected to seesaw, particularly Telebras, the underlying share for the most active options on the market.
"It is difficult to predict the day's trend when it's options time," said a trader.
Market welcomed congressional approval of a bill allowing presidential re-election late Wednesday, but it remains concerned about slow progress of key constitutional reforms.
Traders also said they will await further announcements on the Band B cellular selloff.

On Wednesday, the Communications Ministry released the names of the qualified bidders competing for cellular concessions. It also announced the first winning group. A Canadian-led group won the concession to run cellular services in central Brazil, paying some 25.4 percent above the base price.
But investors are still waiting for the bids presented by the consortia to operate the choicest areas, Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro states.
